session_summary.task: Follow-up to PR #44: Add dark mode background overrides for callout blocks so they render correctly in dark mode.
session_summary.context: PR #44 added the dark mode toggle and Base.astro pre-paint theme detection, but the callout background colors were not updated for dark mode. User identified that the Founding Contribution section (which uses .callout--info class) and other callout blocks need dark backgrounds in dark mode.
key_changes: Converted crisis banner gradient from hardcoded #1a1a2e to var(--color-bg-dark) CSS variable
Made .hero--dark adaptive in light mode (var(--color-bg-alt)) and kept dark gradient in dark mode
Added dark mode overrides for .btn--outline-light (border, background, hover state)

commit.message: [HERMES] fix(theme): add dark mode callout backgrounds and fix crisis banner variable

decisions_made.decision: Use CSS variable-based dark mode backgrounds for callouts
decisions_made.rationale: Matches the existing dark mode pattern introduced in PR #44 (uses [data-theme='dark'] attribute selector)

decisions_pending.decision: Audit other components for hardcoded light-mode colors
decisions_pending.rationale: User indicated 'there's a lot that need to be changed to a dark background' — the current PR addresses callout blocks but a broader audit may be needed for full dark mode coverage
